field_text_formatted.value: A server-rendered production build then has a clear endpoint, POST /_druxt/cache/clear, locked to the secret in an X-Druxt-Secret header. Each Nuxt process keeps its own cache, so a site running several clears each one. List Druxt, or a module that adds it such as druxt-site, under modules rather than buildModules, or the endpoint answers 404 under nuxt start.
